custom_logic_notes: The 'Karpenko' custom indicator has two buffers: buffer 0 (main line) and buffer 1 (signal line). Entry logic checks crossover/crossunder on bar at SignalBar offset (default 1). If SignalBar==0, signals are recalculated every tick. The EA uses CIsNewBar class from TradeAlgorithms.mqh for new bar detection. Signal reversal exits are gated by BuyPosClose/SellPosClose input booleans. Entry is gated by BuyPosOpen/SellPosOpen input booleans. GlobalVariableDel_ cleanup on deinit. LoadHistory() call ensures bar data availability. The crossover detection checks Ind[1]>Sign[1] on the older bar and Ind[0]<=Sign[0] on the newer bar for long entry (and vice versa for short).
external_dependencies: TradeAlgorithms.mqh — provides BuyPositionClose, SellPositionClose, BuyPositionOpen, SellPositionOpen, CIsNewBar, GlobalVariableDel_, LoadHistory
Karpenko indicator — custom indicator with two buffers, params: Basic_MA=144, History=500
python_conversion_notes: Must reverse-engineer or obtain the Karpenko custom indicator source to reimplement its two-buffer logic in Python. The TradeAlgorithms.mqh order management functions (BuyPositionOpen, SellPositionOpen, BuyPositionClose, SellPositionClose) need Python equivalents. The crossover logic is straightforward: main line crosses above signal line for long, below for short. Fixed SL=1000 points, TP=2000 points. Position sizing supports multiple modes via MarginMode enum — at minimum implement LOT (fixed lot) mode. New bar guard ensures one signal per bar. SignalBar=1 means signals are evaluated on the previous completed bar, which aligns well with backtest bar-by-bar simulation.
